COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Implementation and Reflection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation and Reflection.
   B. Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Implementation and Reflection as rumours only.
   D. Say Implementation and Reflection never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup.
   B. Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup as rumours only.
   D. Say Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Advocacy in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Advocacy in the Community as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community.
   D. Say Advocacy in the Community never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.
   B. Say Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 as rumours only.
   D. Explain Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Problem Validation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Problem Validation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation.
   C. Say Problem Validation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Problem Validation as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship.
   D. Treat Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

9. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.

10. Which statement about Making Important Choices is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices.
   B. Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Making Important Choices as rumours only.
   D. Say Making Important Choices never happens in Kenya.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   B. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   D. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Making Important Choices and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Validation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Implementation and Reflection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Nairobi

2. B — Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. B — Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Explain Advocacy in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A — Explain Problem Validation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

9. A — Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. B — Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Plan income and spending wisely

12. D — Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Problem Validation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
